post.originalText:
Yo! Opus 5.5. RAW, UNFILTERED!! 🙀🙀

Been seeing this trend on X and decided to try this out.

Gave it one single prompt: "Make a dynamic 15-second motion graphics video that shows what an incredible motion designer you are, like it's your showreel for a resume. Go all out."

The results? Mind-blowing! Might need some work. But imagine what this could do with detailed prompting...
